content.text:
Halloween flight complete. Recap:

**Setup** — One campaign ("Yuzustride Halloween Trial 2027"), two line items (one per approved post), ALL_ON_TWITTER placements, US + Canada, iOS/Android only, Anime interest, optimizing for link clicks (no X pixel on the site, so trial starts can't be measured directly — clicks on the halloween page were the proxy). Budget $700 across both; started 50/50, shifted toward Post A on Oct 25 and again on Oct 28 after it won on cost per click.

**Results (Oct 23–31 ET)**
- Total spend: **$666.52** of $700
- Impressions: **448,661**
- Link clicks: **271** (~$2.46/click)
  - Post 2244664939118766301 ("underdog relay"): $457.89, 259,197 impressions, 203 clicks (~$2.26/click)
  - Post 2244846133049296813 ("deadline"): $208.63, 189,464 impressions, 68 clicks (~$3.07/click)

Post A was the clear winner and got the majority of the budget in the back half. The campaign has ended (line items expired Oct 31 11:59pm ET; I paused the campaign afterward).

**Caveats / flags**
- X cannot see trial starts (no pixel), so I can't report conversions or true cost per trial. If you want that measured, add the X pixel or an app-event tag and a WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS goal next flight.
- Spend came in ~$33 under budget because line items stopped at end of flight and pacing is standard.
- Note the copy promises trials are iOS/Android US/Canada only — targeting matched that.
